title: I Cry Out Day and Night Before You

questions.question: O Lord, God of my salvation, I cry out day and night before whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 88:1 (ESV): "O Lord, God of my salvation, I cry out day and night before you."

questions.question: Let my prayer come before you; incline your ear to my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 88:2 (ESV): "Let my prayer come before you; incline your ear to my cry!"

questions.question: For my soul is full of troubles, and my life draws near to what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 88:3 (ESV): "For my soul is full of troubles, and my life draws near to Sheol."

questions.question: I am counted among those who go down to the pit; I am a man who has no what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 88:4 (ESV): "...I am a man who has no strength,"

questions.question: Like one set loose among the dead, like the slain that lie in the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 88:5 (ESV): "...like the slain that lie in the grave,"

questions.question: You have put me in the depths of the pit, in the regions dark and what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 88:6 (ESV): "...in the regions dark and deep."

questions.question: Your wrath lies heavy upon me, and you overwhelm me with all your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 88:7 (ESV): "...and you overwhelm me with all your waves."

questions.question: You have caused my companions to shun me; you have made me a horror to whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 88:8 (ESV): "...you have made me a horror to them."

questions.question: I am shut in so that I cannot escape; my eye grows dim through what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 88:9 (ESV): "...my eye grows dim through sorrow."

questions.question: Every day I call upon you, O Lord; I spread out my hands to whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 88:9 (ESV): "...I spread out my hands to you."

questions.question: Do you work wonders for the dead? Do the departed rise up to do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 88:10 (ESV): "Do the departed rise up to praise you?"

questions.question: Is your steadfast love declared in the grave, or your faithfulness in where?
Are your wonders known in the darkness, or your righteousness in the land of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 88:12 (ESV): "...or your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?"

questions.question: But I, O Lord, cry to you; in the morning my prayer comes before whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 88:13 (ESV): "...in the morning my prayer comes before you."

questions.question: You have caused my beloved and my friend to shun me; my companions have become what?

key_verse_text: O Lord, God of my salvation, I cry out day and night before you.
